scope_providers.evidence: OWNER_TERMS_ACCEPTED_AND_DOCUMENTED_PLAN_SCOPE; personal, local, noncommercial use. Alpaca Basic includes the IEX real-time feed and the documented historical SIP access older than 15 minutes; single-venue IEX only. Personal noncommercial display and valuation are supported by the accepted terms. Cache and retention are NOT attested: the terms do not grant blanket storage or redistribution, so observations stay in memory only. Sources: docs.alpaca.markets about-market-data-api / market-data-faq, files.alpaca.markets TermsAndConditions.pdf
scope_providers.cache_rights_note: The earlier DENIED value was a coding-assistant default, not a documented contractual denial. Nothing in the accepted terms was found to authorise persistent storage either, so the specific capabilities are PENDING_RIGHTS_VERIFICATION and memory-only behaviour is unchanged until evidence establishes otherwise.

scope_providers.evidence: OWNER_TERMS_ACCEPTED_AND_DOCUMENTED_PLAN_SCOPE; personal, local, noncommercial use. Free Forever terms (2026-10-26) permit a personal localhost dashboard and storage on a device the Owner controls while the account is open, with deletion on closure; no additional provider-side derived-data restriction, while exchange agreements still govern. Data is at least 24 h delayed and is labelled HISTORICAL_DELAYED_LAST, never real-time or an official EOD close. Sources: marketdata.app/terms, docs/account/free-accounts, docs/account/entitlements, docs/account/data-freshness
scope_providers.retention_condition: retain while the account is open; delete on account closure

scope_providers.evidence: Owner authorised private, non-commercial storage on 2026-11-04 (ODR_UPI_MARKET_DATA_004_AMENDMENT_004_PRIVATE_STORAGE). Scope: parsed daily OHLCV for the held universe and benchmarks in a private warehouse, with no redistribution, no public derived benchmark and no model training; purge within 30 days of the terms or plan ending. The terms basis is the Owner's research summary of the 2026-11-03 revision, not an agent browse; third-party provider and exchange terms still apply.

scope_providers.evidence: Owner authorised private display, calculation and derived use of the BOT reference FX on 2026-11-04 (ODR_UPI_MARKET_DATA_004_AMENDMENT_004_PRIVATE_STORAGE). The adapter contract was verified against live responses on 2026-11-04: /Stat-ExchangeRate/v2/DAILY_AVG_EXG_RATE/ with start_period/end_period, rows under result.data.data_detail filtered to USD, mid_rate as THB per one USD. The rate is a weighted-average interbank reference, never an executable brokerage conversion.
